jobs.description:
_**Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At COWI, we are strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure. We are looking for an experienced Mechanical Lead with a background from data centre projects to help strengthen and expand our growing data centre business across Scandinavia.

**_

**Lead the mechanical design of next-generation data centres

**Data centres are a strategic growth area at COWI, and we are continuing to strengthen our multidisciplinary capabilities across Scandinavia. By combining expertise in engineering, architecture, sustainability and project delivery, we support clients throughout the development of complex digital infrastructure projects and help shape the next generation of reliable and energy-efficient facilities. Your work location wil be at one of COWI'S offices in either Lyngby, Aarhus or Odense based on your preference.

In this role, you will take a leading position within the mechanical discipline, contributing your expertise to complex projects from early planning through detailed design and implementation.

As Mechanical Lead, you will play a key role in developing cooling and HVAC solutions for mission-critical facilities, balancing performance, reliability and sustainability requirements. Working closely with colleagues across engineering disciplines, architects and clients, you will help ensure technically robust and coordinated solutions throughout the project lifecycle. We expect that you have work experience from hyperscale data centre projects.

You will join an established engineering environment where technical quality, collaboration and knowledge sharing are highly valued. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the continued development of our data centre expertise and project delivery capabilities across Scandinavia.

**Your key responsibilities will be to:

**

• Lead mechanical design and advisory services for data centre facilities.

• Act as the discipline lead, ensuring technical quality and coordination throughout projects.

• Lead the design and development of mechanical systems for hyperscale and enterprise data centers.

• Engage with clients and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical engineering solutions.

• Support projects through concept development, detailed design, tendering and construction phases.

• Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams to deliver integrated and efficient technical solutions.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

**On top of that, you will have:

**

• A relevant educational background in engineering.

• Proven experience delivering data centre projects, ideally within hyperscale, colocation or enterprise environments.

• Experience leading technical design work within multidisciplinary project environments.

• Professional proficiency in English.

• Additional role-specific qualifications may include:

• Experience working with large-scale infrastructure or industrial facilities.

Some projects may be subject to specific security requirements, and the ability to obtain relevant security clearance may be required.

**Do you have more questions?

**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Talent Acuisition Specialist, Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com. Get to know our work with data centre projects even better here: Can you make tomorrow’s digital infrastructure feel at home?

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so the role may close as soon as we find the right match.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

**About The Role

**As a Senior Observability Engineer at Saxo, you will join a specialised team responsible for the bank's observability platforms. We build and continuously improve solutions that provide visibility into the performance, stability, and health of critical business systems across our hybrid infrastructure.

You will help shape the future of Saxo's observability landscape by designing and operating solutions for metrics, logs, traces, and events across cloud and on-premises environments. Your work will enable engineering teams to better understand, monitor, and improve the systems that power Saxo.

**Team perspective

**_"We are the eyes and ears of Saxo Bank's platform health. Our work is critical to maintaining stable and continuous operations across the organisation.

__Our team is based in Denmark and India and consists of five specialists. While supporting our current platforms, we are also executing our roadmap for the next generation of observability capabilities."

_**Responsibilities

**

• Own and support the day-to-day operation of Saxo's observability platform.

• Partner closely with engineering teams to deliver meaningful monitoring and visibility across business-critical systems.

• Drive priorities, technical direction, and platform improvements within the team.

• Act as the observability platform architect, ensuring scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

• Play a key role in delivering the next generation of Saxo's observability platform in collaboration with Enterprise Architecture, platform teams, and business stakeholders.

**What Success Looks Like

**

• Build expertise across our observability ecosystem, including Elastic, Grafana, Kibana, Kubernetes, SCOM, and Windows Server.

• Improve visibility, reliability, and operational efficiency by reducing alert noise, enhancing dashboards, and driving actionable insights.

• Define and promote standards for logging, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.

• Collaborate with engineering, platform, and security teams to ensure observability is embedded across solutions.

• Lead incident investigations, contribute to post-mortems, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.

• Optimise platform performance, scalability, and cost.

• Share knowledge through documentation, best practices, and technical guidance across the organisation.

**Your profile

**You have 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or a similar role, with a strong focus on observability.

**You Bring Hands-on Experience With Observability Technologies Such As

**

• Metrics: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, or similar.

• Logging: Elastic Stack, Splunk, Loki, Cloud Logging, or similar.

• Tracing: OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin, X-Ray, or equivalent tracing solutions.

**You Also Have Experience With

**

• SRE practices, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, and incident management.

• Distributed systems and cloud-native architectures.

• Operating and optimising Elastic Stack in production environments.

• Grafana and Kibana for dashboarding, visualisation, and alerting.

• Windows Server administration and monitoring, ideally including SCOM.

• Public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

• Kubernetes, Docker, and container-based environments.

• Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD tooling (Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, Pulumi, GitOps, etc.).

• Scripting or development experience in languages such as Java, Python, or Node.js.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

**Join a world of energy as MFT Energy’s new Quantitative Researcher

**Do you love math, solving complex problems, writing code, and working closely with people who share your ambition? Are you motivated by turning ideas into solutions, testing them in the real world, and seeing the results of your work? Then you might be our new Quantitative Researcher!

**The job as Quantitative Researcher

**You will be part of our Gas trading team, working closely with traders, researchers and engineers who challenge each other, share knowledge and keep improving their solutions. The team works with short feedback loops and focuses on getting ideas into practice quickly. We also use AI extensively in our daily work, and we expect you to be curious about how modern AI tools can help us work smarter, develop faster and solve more complex problems.

As our new Quantitative Researcher, you will work where quantitative analysis, technology and energy trading meet. You’ll help identify opportunities, develop quantitative models and turn market insights into trading strategies. One day you might be exploring a market opportunity or building a forecasting model. The next, you could be improving data pipelines or building solutions that make our trading more effective.

**In this role you will

**

• Develop and improve quantitative models and market forecasts that support trading decisions

• Work closely with traders and researchers to identify, analyse and evaluate market opportunities

• Design, develop and maintain Python-based tools and models

• Research, backtest and evaluate trading ideas and strategies

• Transform complex market data into practical insights and actionable solutions

• Use AI tools to speed up development, research and problem-solving

• Continuously improve existing models, systems and processes based on feedback and performance

• Take ownership of your work from initial idea through implementation and ongoing improvement

**About You

**You are self-driven, curious and pragmatic, with the drive to turn ideas into working solutions. You enjoy working with others, exchanging ideas and learning from your colleagues, and you are motivated by seeing your work put into practice. You take ownership of your models from first idea to live trading. Experience with energy markets, quantitative trading or forecasting is an advantage, but your mindset, technical capabilities and willingness to learn matter most to us.

We welcome applications from both recent graduates and experienced professionals, as we value talent, curiosity, and the right mindset over years of experience.

**What You Need To Succeed

**

• A relevant technical or quantitative background, such as mathematics, physics, engineering or a related field

• Strong coding skills and a real passion for technology

• Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills

• A natural curiosity about markets, data and how energy markets work

• You believe the best results come from working together, and you thrive with short feedback loops

• An interest in AI and a willingness to explore new tools and ways of working

• Fluent in English, spoken and written, as our company language is English

**Bonus points if you bring

**

• Experience with energy markets, quantitative trading or forecasting

**Working in MFT Energy

**At MFT Energy, we combine a startup mindset with the strength of a global organization. We believe in empowering individuals to make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment. We are around 200 employees working out of our headquarters in Aarhus C, and from our international offices in Türkiye, Australia, New York, Singapore, Japan, and several remote colleagues working from all over the world.

**You can look forward to

**

• An international and dynamic environment where priorities evolve with the business

• Close collaboration with skilled and ambitious colleagues across trading, research and technology

• The opportunity to see your models and ideas put into practice quickly in live trading

• Competitive benefits and the opportunity to grow with the company

• The chance to one day become partner

• A flat organization where responsibility and initiative are valued

• A culture where we enjoy celebrating both big and small successes - and luckily, we have many reasons to do so

**Make the Most of Your Talent! Join us!

**Include your CV and answer the questions in the application form instead of writing a traditional cover letter. Share concrete examples of your experience and competencies - it gives us a much better sense of who you are! Feel free to use AI, just don't let it write for you. We want to get to know the real you.

For questions, please contact career@mft-energy.com.

Start date: As soon as possible.

We will be screening and interviewing candidates on an ongoing basis.

_MFT Energy does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms. Any resume submitted without a valid, written agreement with MFT Energy will not create any obligations on MFT Energy to pay a placement fee if that candidate is subsequently hired.

_As a global and independent energy trading hub, we specialize in power, gas, and environmentals trading 24/7 in 41 countries. At MFT Energy, we innovate energy trading through our people and technology, supported by our unique partner model. We believe that fostering a sense of ownership among employees is the most effective way to advance our business.

Build the platform every engineering team depends on and shape how Performativ scales through reliability, resilience, and world-class developer experience.

As our Hands-On Lead Cloud Engineer, you will lead Mission Control, our Platform Engineering and Reliability team. Mission Control creates secure, self-service platform capabilities that enable product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll spend the majority of your time building production infrastructure and platform capabilities, leading through technical contribution rather than process.

**What You’ll Do 📈

**

• Lead Mission Control while remaining deeply hands-on across cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and reliability.

• Build and evolve the default, secure-by-default platform that enables product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

• Create reusable AWS CDK constructs, infrastructure standards, and golden paths that reduce complexity and improve the developer experience across engineering.

• Set the technical direction for Mission Control, making pragmatic decisions about platform evolution, reliability, and developer experience while helping the team execute.

• Strengthen our reliability practices through SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident tooling, and post-incident improvements that drive meaningful change.

• Treat cloud cost as a first-class engineering concern by improving visibility, eliminating waste, and designing systems that scale efficiently.

• Partner closely with our security specialists to build secure-by-default platform capabilities and continuously strengthen our security posture.

• Own the evolution of the engineering platform that enables every product team to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

• Provide technical leadership, coaching, and feedback to a small team of experienced platform engineers while remaining deeply involved in delivery.

**What We’re Looking For 🎯

**

• 7+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar production-focused environments.

• Experience leading or mentoring engineers while remaining hands-on and actively contributing to code and infrastructure.

• Strong experience designing and operating production workloads on AWS, including Infrastructure as Code. Experience with AWS CDK and TypeScript is strongly preferred.

• Strong understanding of the AWS Well-Architected Framework and practical application of its principles.

• A platform engineering mindset focused on building reusable capabilities, self-service, and engineering leverage.

• Strong operational judgment with experience in incident response, reliability engineering, SLOs, and continuous improvement.

• Comfort owning outcomes, making decisions in ambiguous environments, and improving engineering practices without adding unnecessary process.

• Actively leverages AI and agent-assisted engineering workflows to improve productivity while applying sound engineering judgment and maintaining high quality standards.

• Experience working within fintech or other regulated industries is a plus.

**Technologies you'll work with 💻

**You don't need experience with every technology listed below. We care far more about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and your ability to learn, build, and improve systems.

• Infrastructure & Cloud: AWS CDK (TypeScript), Terraform (bonus), and modern AWS infrastructure, networking, security, governance, and observability services.

• Engineering Tooling: GitHub Actions, Docker, container pipelines, cloud cost optimization, and observability tooling.

• Wider Engineering Stack: You'll collaborate with teams building services primarily in Golang and TypeScript, alongside React, React Native, Python, and PHP.

**What We Can Offer You 🌱

**

• Trust and responsibility to shape the future of Performativ’s success in the European market from day 1.

• Join a fast-growing fintech scaleup supported by top-tier VCs.

• Work with intelligent, passionate, and driven professionals with experience from leading institutions (such as Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon etc).

• Accelerate your career with opportunities for professional development and leadership.

**Join a Team of Fintech heroes! 🚀

**Performativ is making waves in the wealth management ecosystem and is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions do business around the world. Working at Performativ means working at a fast-paced tech scaleup with intelligent people who are passionate about their work. We are on a scaling journey beyond all metrics and expectations and can't wait to have you join us in making a real impact.

We are funded by some of the leading VC funds in the world and expectations are set to be established as a European market leader in a record amount of time.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

**We value passion 🔥

**At Performativ, we are builders first. We are passionate with ambitious goals and value the time and effort people put into their work. You will be part of the family from day one, and responsible for making your mark and driving forward your vision. Autonomous work is embedded in our culture, and we are committed to ensure you have all the tools and support you need while acknowledging the importance of flexibility.

Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• 
Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.

• 
Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.

• 
Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.

• 
Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.

• 
Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.

• 
Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

You’re a great match if

• 
You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team

• 
You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off

• 
You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them

• 
You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team

• 
You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

Nice to have

• Experience working on live games

Requirements for any job at Triband

• 
You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• 
You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture

• 
You value a positive work environment

• 
You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

Practicalities

• 
Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen

• 
Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role

• 
37-hour work week, with flexible work hours

• 
No crunch, we put people before deadlines

• 
Our working language is English

We offer

• 
Silly but ambitious projects

• 
The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players

• 
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged

• 
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• 
A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• 
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events

• 
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• 
Six weeks of paid vacation

• 
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement

• 
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• 
Pension plan and private health insurance

• 
Endless amounts of coffee

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

Do you enjoy making systems? Are you also pretty silly? Would you like to collaborate with other creative people to make a game that makes people laugh?

Triband is working on our most ambitious project to date: a new systemic open-world game and a brand-new IP (this is not a WHAT THE? game). It’s something different, and currently still in the early days of development. As a Senior Game Programmer you'll be responsible for building the tech and underlying systems.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• 
In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you'll build new features for a game with an existing tech infrastructure, continuously iterating on improvements.

• 
You’ll be one of the team’s domain experts, including balancing long-term code health with short-term needs and sharing best practices with your team mates.

• 
We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor.

• 
Overall, you'll make sure the project is great to work on.

This includes things like...

• 
Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility, with multi-platform support in mind.

• 
Implementing core systems, such as data storage, localization, analytics, etc.

• 
Helping designers, artists, and everyone else make their work as awesome as possible.

Must-haves

• 
At least 6 years of experience in game development in a similar role.

• 
Worked on multiple games as part of a team, and have been a part of the different stages of development.

• 
Proficiency in C# and a deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor, including its asset pipeline and editor tooling.

• 
Experience shipping iOS and macOS apps with hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework, using Xcode and Swift.

Nice-to-haves

• 
Experience maintaining a live game, including coordinating and implementing updates, managing app store submissions, and keeping a live player base happy.

• 
Experience with Unity rendering pipeline, shader programming, and performance optimization for different platforms.

• 
Experience working with automated build pipelines like Jenkins.

What always matters to us at Triband

The project you'll join is something new, but our ways of working are the same. We’ve always believed that games are made by teams, not solo rockstars, and good ideas can come from anyone. We love people who bring curiosity, generosity, flexibility, and strong opinions, especially when those opinions come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to validate ideas properly.

We also care a lot about experimentation. Sometimes the weird idea is not the right fit. Sometimes the weird idea is the entire game! The trick is being able to explore it together, learn from it, and not get too precious when the experience tells us we’re wrong.

Practicalities

• 
We don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.

• 
We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• 
We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• 
No crunch. People over deadlines.

• 
Our working language is English.

We offer

• 
Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• 
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• 
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• 
A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• 
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• 
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• 
Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer for The Tech Collective
jobs.description:
We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

**What You'll Do

**This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

**In This Role, You'll

**

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

**What You'll Bring

**We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

**Beyond That, You'll Bring

**

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

**What We Offer

**You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

At GetWhy, we’re on a mission to change the way brands understand people. We help the world's biggest brands get closer to their consumers—faster, smarter, and with a human touch - through breakthrough research powered by AI. Companies like Coca-Cola, Heineken, Unilever and more trust us to deliver consumer insights in hours, not weeks.

We are building an end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform, redefining the boundaries of qualitative research. To fuel our journey, we raised a $34.5M Series A investment from PeakSpan Capital in 2024, making it one of Denmark’s largest Series A rounds to date.

What the AI team does

We are dedicated to delivering high-quality AI products leveraging the latest tools and techniques and to serve them across our core products in a scalable way.

For this, we use classic machine learning for predictive models to deal with fraud detection, language classification, visual understanding and automating internal workflows. These make heavy use of video processing, speech-to-text and multilingual translations models and pipelines.

We also build a lot of functionality around state of the art LLMs. We treat off-the-shelf LLMs as future commodities and aim to benefit from their strengths while employing principled methodologies to build guardrails and fallback strategies for their weaknesses. We strive to achieve a deep understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and LLM behavior quirks (e.g., hallucinations, non-determinism, context management), by focusing on evaluation and observability through monitoring for latency, accuracy, and usage.

Who you are

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our growing stellar AI team. You will be responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across projects, from designing and defining data annotation steps to model training, validation and deployment.

More Specifically, You Should Have These Minimum Qualifications

• At least 5+ years developing machine learning systems, in particular NLP models.

• Proficiency in Python, along with a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms, and the capability to write production-quality code.

• Significant experience working with LLMs at scale, Prompt Engineering and AI Agents.

• Solid understanding of LLM evaluation, dealing with hallucinations, inconsistent outputs, context management, conversational AI and voice technologies, including text-to-speech.

• Proven experience formulating hypotheses, conducting experiments, and analyzing results.

• Exceptional English skills, both spoken and in writing.

What you will do

• Build AI-powered features at scale using the latest advancements in LLMs.

• Research, prototype, and build advanced NLP/ML models to enable automated resolution of end-user problems.

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments and evaluations to enhance model accuracy and reliability.

• Refine prompts and tune hyper-parameters to maximize the performance of cutting-edge retrieval and generative AI systems.

• Work closely with researchers, engineers, and product teams to define feature scope and implementation strategies.

• Mentor junior team members and engage in collaborative learning with peers to promote knowledge sharing.

• Contribute to technical reviews and share expertise in ML methodologies and best practices

• Writing clean, maintainable, and well-structured code to meet delivery goals.

What we offer

• A highly ambitious AI team driven by sky-is-the-limit long term vision and goals, while working to identify and deliver intermediate milestones.

• A full-time position with a competitive salary plus benefits.

• A flexible work schedule with opportunities to work from home.

• A vibrant and international work environment with 60+ colleagues from 15+ nationalities.

• A modern, newly renovated Nordhavnen office with stunning waterfront views, office lunch, relaxation areas, gym, free daily energizers, snacks, and drinks.

• A company culture that values innovation, collaboration, and transparency.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events – we work hard, we celebrate hard.

How do I apply?

Click on the apply button and upload your resumé or LinkedIn profile. If we see a potential match, we’ll invite you for a conversation at our office to get to know you better and share more about our culture and this opportunity.

So, what are you waiting for? Hit the apply button and come join the next Danish unicorn.

Maersk’s Protective Services function helps keep our executive leadership, their families and designated senior leaders safe, connected and able to lead the business with confidence. We do this through intelligence-led advice, structured programmes and discreet coordination across the countries where Maersk operates.

We are looking for an Executive Protection Advisor to take ownership of our Executive Protection and Event Security programmes; co-own the executive scope of our Travel Risk Management programme and the family coverage within our Expat and Family Security Programme; and act as a trusted advisor to senior executives across Maersk and A.P. Moller Holding, as well as designated family members.

This role is for someone who leads through structure and judgement rather than visibility. You can balance operational delivery with programme development, build trust with senior stakeholders, and translate exposure into proportionate, discreet and workable solutions.

The role in brief

The Executive Protection Advisor is the trusted operational and advisory point of contact for our executive population and their closest support functions. The role sits at the centre of a global Protective Services team and works directly with the Head of Protective Services.

Approximately 60% of the role is operational. You will advise on executive travel, events, residences and family security situations; manage incidents and threats when they arise; and coordinate with Regional Heads of Security, vendors and authorities to ensure the right support is in the right place at the right time.

The remaining 40% is strategic. You will own and continuously develop the Executive Protection Programme and the Event Security Programme. You will also co-own the executive scope of Travel Risk Management and the coverage for families of Maersk’s executive leadership within our Expat and Family Security Programme, while contributing to the continued professional maturity of the function.

International travel is part of the role, including support for events, oversight of site visits, and the development and maintenance of vendor relationships. The role is based in Copenhagen.

What you will do

Programme ownership and development

·  Own the Executive Protection Programme (EPP), including its appendices, procedures and workflows, and ensure it remains current and operationally usable.

·  Own the Event Security Programme (ESP), including triggers, templates, planning standards and governance.

·  Co-own the executive travel scope of our Travel Risk Management programme and the family coverage within our Expat and Family Security Programme.

·  Prepare decision-ready executive briefings for leadership review and approval.

Executive, family and residential advisory

·  Act as the trusted contact for senior executives and designated family members on protective services matters.

·  Conduct individual exposure assessments and translate findings into proportionate, discreet, and practical measures.

·  Coordinate residential security across alarms, access control, surveillance, physical improvements and vendor delivery.

Executive travel and event coordination

·  Coordinate protective services for senior executive travel.

·  Plan and oversee event security for leadership events, off-sites and public engagements.

·  Coordinate with Regional Heads of Security, local offices, vendors and authorities to ensure consistent delivery.

Incident, threat and harassment case management

·  Lead the initial assessment of threats, harassment or incidents affecting executives, family members, or company locations.

·  Coordinate with Global Threat Intelligence, Cyber Security, Legal, HQ Security, and relevant authorities.

·  Maintain clear documentation, follow-up actions, and After-Action Reviews.

Intelligence, vendors and authorities

·  Define Protective Services’ intelligence requirements and coordinate with Global Threat Intelligence.

·  Support vendor evaluations, RFP processes and procurement collaboration across executive protection, residential security, event security and intelligence suppliers.

·  Build and maintain professional relationships with Danish and international police, authorities and security partners.

Training and onboarding

·  Deliver security onboarding and briefings for new members of Maersk’s executive leadership, Executive Assistants and relevant support functions.

·  Develop audience-appropriate awareness materials, briefings, and checklists.

About you

You are a trusted advisor, not a frontline operator. You bring the composure of someone who has worked closely with senior leadership, and you understand that judgement and discretion matter more than visibility in this environment.

You are structured, take ownership and follow matters through to closure. You are comfortable with ambiguity, able to bring orders to incomplete information, and confident in turning it into a workable plan.

You are proactive and anticipate what is coming. You engage early with Executive Assistants, regional partners and vendors, ensuring Protective Services remains a step ahead.

You communicate with clarity and confidence. You can turn a complex security topic into a concise, decision-ready briefing for a senior leader, and you can raise concerns respectfully but firmly when the situation requires it.

You understand that this is a people-focused role. Trust is the foundation, discretion is the standard and continuity is essential to effective delivery.

Qualifications

Required

·  Danish citizenship, as the role requires eligibility for national security clearance and professional cooperation with Danish authorities, including the Police and PET.

·  A relevant background in corporate protective services, executive protection, security risk management, intelligence, police, military or diplomatic security.

·  Documented experience of working professionally with authorities on security matters, or a demonstrated ability to build and maintain such relationships.

·  Experience in at least two of the following four core areas: executive protection; family and residential security; event security; or executive travel coordination.

·  Strong judgement and the ability to act autonomously in sensitive situations.

·  Exceptional discretion and interpersonal awareness.

·  Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

·  A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel internationally.

Preferred

·  Experience in a global corporate environment with executive stakeholders.

·  Experience developing and maintaining security programmes, procedures, or playbooks.

·  Experience coordinating with Regional Security teams across multiple geographies.

·  Working knowledge of ISO 31030 (Travel Risk Management) or similar standards.

·  Experience with vendor evaluation, procurement collaboration, and performance oversight.

·  Danish language skills.

We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. About the Role

Our GTM organization is at an inflection point after reaching more than €100M ARR in 2025. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem needs to evolve from a system of record into a true platform for growth – flexible, well-governed and built to support increasingly complex go-to-market motions. You'll be responsible for the technical architecture and long-term health of our Salesforce instance, translating ambitious business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions.

You'll own the architecture and design standards across our Salesforce ecosystem. This is a hands-on technical role at the intersection of CRM architecture, systems integration and revenue operations. You'll collaborate closely with the GTM leadership team, RevOps, Data and Analytics team to ensure our Salesforce platform scales cleanly alongside the business. Your core accountability is simple: design and steward a Salesforce architecture that is scalable, secure and built to last.

Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end solution architecture of our Salesforce ecosystem, including data model, security model, sharing rules and integration architecture to support a global, multi-function GTM organisation spanning Self Serve, Partner-Led and High Touch motions.Translate complex business requirements from Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance into scalable, well-governed technical designs.

• Define and enforce architectural standards, coding conventions and release management best practices across the Salesforce platform.

• Design and oversee integrations between Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack (marketing automation, data enrichment tools, billing, data warehouse) using APIs, middleware and event-driven architecture.

• Partner with RevOps and the GTM org to evaluate buy vs. build decisions and guide platform-native solutions over custom code wherever possible.

• Lead technical design reviews, identify risks or technical debt early and ensure solutions are secure, performant and compliant with data governance requirements.

• Stay at the frontier of the Salesforce ecosystem – continuously evaluate new platform capabilities (Data Cloud, Agentforce, Flow) and bring the right innovations into our architecture roadmap.

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Salesforce architecture, solution engineering or senior Salesforce development roles.

Technical Skills

• Deep fluency in Salesforce architecture fundamentals: data modeling, security/sharing model, Flow, Apex, LWC, and integration patterns.

• Strong practical experience designing integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Workato or similar) and event-driven architecture.

**

Operating Skills**

Building keeps getting cheaper every quarter. What used to take a senior engineer a few weeks now takes an afternoon. The work that does not get cheaper is helping a real business absorb new technology, sequencing the rollout, and knowing when to slow down because something is starting to break under load.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer. Someone who goes into a client, understands the operation, spots where the real optimisation potential sits, and pushes it all the way through to execution with a strong engineering team behind them.

The role sits between engineering and consulting without fitting cleanly into either. You need to be technical enough to understand data and AI at a deep level. Commercial enough to spot where the business value sits. Patient enough to sit with a manager who is genuinely worried about the tool you just put in front of them. And stubborn enough to stay around once the launch excitement fades and the real adoption work begins.

Most people are strong in one of those. Some in two. Almost nobody walks in with all four. That is exactly the profile we are looking for.

What you will work on

You will embed directly with clients to understand the operation and where the real value sits. You will drive adoption by sequencing rollouts, working with the people who have to use the tool, and staying through the unglamorous part. You will translate business needs into AI solutions that actually ship. And you will learn when to push, when to slow down, and when something is starting to break under load.

You work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists, and designers in a company where the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

**Requirements

**Experience with management consulting, change management, or adoption of AI solutions in production. An understanding of software development, ML or data engineering. Familiarity with AI and GenAI frameworks, possibly with some MLOps and evals exposure. Experience with cloud environments like Azure or GCP.

Coding with agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Working directly with clients and stakeholders. Owning delivery end to end, from a vague problem to a live, adopted solution.

Curiosity, taste and a builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

People here care about what they build. Good ideas move quickly. New technology gets explored early. There is room to shape both the company and the way we work.

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

**

**As Genmab continues its transformation into a fully integrated global biotech company, the Head of Total Rewards will architect a future-ready, technology-enabled global rewards strategy that aligns with our purpose, growth ambitions, and values.

This leader will combine expertise in executive compensation, global scalability, and digital enablement to create a next-generation total rewards model—anchored in data, automation, and human experience. The role will also build the structures, systems, and shared-service capabilities needed to scale efficiently while maintaining governance, equity, and agility.

The location is flexible across Genmab’s global hubs (Princeton, Copenhagen, Utrecht). We have a hybrid model that requires being onsite 60% of the time.

**Responsibilities

****Strategic Design & Operating Model

**

• Define and lead the evolution of Genmab’s total rewards philosophy and structure to support a global, end-to-end biotech organization.

• Design a modern total rewards operating model that integrates regional teams, shared services, and centers of excellence for consistent global delivery.

• Drive process standardization and automation to improve quality, transparency, and efficiency.

• Lead a strategic compensation team responsible for developing forward-looking frameworks, tools, and analytics that enable proactive support to HR Business Partners, Talent, and other COE stakeholders.

• Ensure the Total Rewards function continuously evolves its offerings to meet the changing needs of a high-growth, science-driven organization.

**Executive Compensation & Governance

**

• Serve as lead advisor to the Board’s Remuneration Committee on executive and equity compensation.

• Design performance-based and ESG-linked long-term incentive plans aligned with Genmab’s business strategy and culture.

• Ensure strong governance, compliance, and transparency in all executive pay matters.

• Bring external perspective and best-in-class practices to inform committee discussions and program evolution, ensuring Genmab remains competitive within the biotech and broader life sciences markets.

**Global Rewards Strategy & Wellbeing

**

• Oversee global compensation, benefits, recognition, and mobility programs that balance competitiveness, scalability, and inclusivity.

• Integrate skills-based pay, internal mobility, and evolving career architectures into the total rewards framework.

• Evolve wellbeing and flexibility offerings through technology and personalized employee experiences.

• Champion employee understanding and appreciation of Total Rewards by partnering with Communications and HR to create clear, engaging messaging that connects programs to our purpose, values, and “EVP”.

• Regularly assess market trends, benchmark data, and emerging innovations to identify opportunities for differentiation and continuous improvement.

**Technology, Automation & Data

**

• Lead implementation of digital total rewards platforms and process automation across compensation, benefits, and equity administration.

• Establish robust analytics capabilities for pay equity, retention risk, and predictive modeling.

• Drive continuous improvement through data insights, benchmarking, and feedback loops.

• Leverage advanced analytics to generate actionable insights for business leaders, enabling data-driven decisions around talent retention, productivity, and performance outcomes.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement

**

• Strengthen global governance structures and ensure alignment with regulatory, financial, and ethical standards.

• Create transparency and consistency through standardized processes, policies, and data.

• Build and mentor a global total rewards team with strong analytical and design skills.

**Requirements

**

• 15+ years of experience in total rewards, with significant leadership in global, complex organizations.

• Deep expertise in executive compensation design, governance, and disclosure.

• Proven success implementing technology, analytics, and automation within HR or total rewards functions.

• Experience designing shared-service or center of excellence models across geographies.

• Strong understanding of compensation and benefits regulations across multiple markets.

• Exceptional ability to influence and communicate at the executive and Board level.

• Demonstrated success leading and developing global teams, fostering capability growth and functional excellence.

• Proven ability to translate external best practices and market intelligence into actionable strategies tailored to the biotech industry.

**Attributes

**

• Visionary leader who designs systems for long-term scalability.

• Digital innovator who applies automation and analytics to improve the employee experience.

• Trusted advisor who balances strategic foresight with operational excellence.

• Inclusive, globally minded leader who champions fairness and sustainability in rewards.

**The Role

**The Senior Manager, Biostatistics acts as a biostatistician supporting the clinical development of compounds as compound lead, primarily up until proof of concept, and/or as trial responsible statistician.

**Responsibilities

**Compound/Indication Level

• Act as lead and main point of contact related to Statistics for designated compound/indication

• Follow scientific and technical progress within the field of biostatistics in drug development and advise of new methodologies that may support innovation and improve efficiencies

• Engage with regulatory authorities on compound/indication level discussions

• Acts as a role model

• Ensures consistency of statistical methods and data handling across trials

• Ensures all compound/indication related work and information is shared between biostatisticians involved in the compound and with the vendor

• Supports compound responsible programmer in developing an integrated database specification

**CDT Member

**

• Responsible for giving statistical input to overall strategy and the synopsis development in the CDT

• Provide scientific advice to the CDT including design of trials, analyses and analyses requiring advanced statistical methodologies/techniques

• Represent the CDT/the company at regulatory meetings, during Key Opinion Leaders meetings, network and/or Partner meetings, as applicable

• Drive design and synopsis development together with relevant stakeholders

• Ensure transparent communication to relevant stakeholders from the CDT

• Ensure availability of integrated database(s), as needed, and planning and conduct of integrated analysis to support development decisions, submissions, and marketing needs

• Support development and communication in relation to communication strategy and/or scientific input to presentations, posters, and articles

Trial Level

• Represent Genmab during meetings/congresses and courses and perform professional networking

• Engage with regulatory authorities on trial level discussions

• Arranges/attends lessons learned to share learnings

• Represents Genmab during Key Opinion Leaders meetings

• Ensure biostatistician review of partner synopsis, protocols, statistical analysis plans, results meetings presentations and clinical trial reports

• Coordinate data transfers from/to business partners in collaboration with the programmer and the data manager, as applicable

**CTT Member

**

• Participate and represent Biostatistics

• Review and provide input to protocol and amendment development

• Perform vendor oversight according to applicable SOPs

• Give input to eCRF setup, edit checks, validation plan, protocol deviations classifications, DSUR, IB updates, tables, figures, and listings etc.

• Review assay validation reports, as applicable

• Perform exploratory analysis, ad hoc analyses, and modelling of data

• Review and approve randomization and stratification plans

• Perform UAT of Randomization part of the IRT system as applicable

• Ensure procedures for blinding are in place as applicable

• Support timely delivery of statistical deliverables

• Responsible for planning and conducting trial result meetings

• Review and approve the CSR

• Attend operational and steering committee meetings, as applicable

• Support regulatory submission/filing activities

**Requirements

**

• MS / PhD or equivalent in a statistical discipline

• 5+ years of experience in relevant area preferred or demonstrated capability

• Experience in statistical analysis, modelling and simulation and adaptive trial designs

• Experience in working with clinical trials

• Preferred experience with oncology clinical trials

• Proficient programming skills in statistical software’s, such as SAS

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Ability to work independently as well as in teams

• Confident, self-reliant, and a quick learner

• Proactive and open-minded

• Ability to prioritize and work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Result and goal-oriented and committed to contributing to the overall success of Genmab
